title: SpaceX Taps Nvidia and Bain to Move Grok AI Beyond Internal Use

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Bain, Snowflake, and Nvidia are the designated launch partners for the new SpaceXSI initiative. To further extend these capabilities, the company has also entered into a partnership with Apollo and Nvidia to develop a new Grok program that allows for the integration of the technology into third-party ecosystems.

These agreements transition the Grok artificial intelligence from internal company operations toward a commercialized model. Nvidia's role in the partnerships centers on providing the computational infrastructure required to deploy the large language models used in the expanding programs.
